name: @zeroroot-ai/gibson-mcp

tools.name: componentize
tools.description: Turn a built artifact into a Gibson component manifest and write it to disk. Use this after building a tool or agent you want to add to the fleet. Validates the artifact against Gibson's component contract. Does not build or push an image.

name.description: Component name, as it will appear in the tenant registry.

version.description: Semantic version of the artifact, e.g. "0.1.0".

image.description: OCI image reference of the built artifact, pinned by digest. Required before it can be enrolled.

language.description: Language the artifact is written in, for the catalog.

capabilities.description: Agent capabilities. Required when kind is "agent".

methods.description: Plugin method names. Required when kind is "plugin".

input_message_type.description: Fully-qualified proto input type. Required when kind is "tool".

output_message_type.description: Fully-qualified proto output type. Required when kind is "tool".

config_schema_json.description: JSON Schema for a plugin's configuration.

path.description: Where to write the manifest. Defaults to "gibson-component.json".

tools.name: gibson_connect
tools.description: Connect this session to a Gibson platform without a restart: enroll this host through the gibson CLI login session if needed, check in, pick the target, start the live mission, and add the platform tools. The settings are kept, so later sessions connect on their own. Call gibson_status afterwards.

platform_url.description: Platform URL. Defaults to the gibson CLI login session or the saved config.

target_id.description: Target id for the live mission. Defaults to the only target in the tenant.

create_target.description: Create a target with this name when none exists, and use it.

target_url.description: URL of the target to create. Defaults to the workspace's git origin, or file://<cwd>.

bootstrap_token.description: One-time enrollment token. Only when the CLI cannot mint one.

ca_cert_path.description: Path to a private CA to trust. Defaults to the CLI session's CA.

callback_insecure.description: Dial the callback endpoint without TLS. Local daemons only.

tools.name: gibson_login
tools.description: Sign in to a Gibson platform as the person running this session. Starts the gibson CLI device flow and returns a URL and a code. The person opens the URL, confirms the code, and then calls gibson_connect. Needed once per host, and again when the login session expires.

platform_url.description: Platform URL, e.g. https://api.example.com. Defaults to the last one used.

tools.name: gibson_status
tools.description: Show how this session is connected to Gibson: the check-in source (dispatched grant, bootstrap token, enrolled host key, or none), the posture (standalone, component, live, task), the platform, tenant, target, mission and run ids, and what is missing if anything.

tools.name: submit_finding
tools.description: Record a security finding in the Gibson knowledge graph. Use this when you discover a real vulnerability, misconfiguration or notable security fact about the target or codebase. Not for progress updates or general observations.

description.description: What the issue is, where it is, and why it matters.

confidence.description: How certain you are, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 1.

evidence.description: A code excerpt, request/response, or log line.

remediation.description: How to fix or mitigate the issue.

target_id.description: Identifier of the affected target or component.

tools.name: validate_component
tools.description: Check an artifact against Gibson's component contract without writing anything. Names every problem it finds.

name.description: Component name, as it will appear in the tenant registry.

version.description: Semantic version of the artifact, e.g. "0.1.0".

image.description: OCI image reference of the built artifact, pinned by digest. Required before it can be enrolled.

language.description: Language the artifact is written in, for the catalog.

capabilities.description: Agent capabilities. Required when kind is "agent".

methods.description: Plugin method names. Required when kind is "plugin".

input_message_type.description: Fully-qualified proto input type. Required when kind is "tool".

output_message_type.description: Fully-qualified proto output type. Required when kind is "tool".

config_schema_json.description: JSON Schema for a plugin's configuration.

instructions: Gibson tools. Call gibson_status to see how this session is connected. Without a platform, call gibson_login and then gibson_connect to enroll this host and start a live mission. The tools listed here are the ones used most; the platform's whole API is reachable through gibson_api_search and gibson_api_call.
